The National Youth Leader of the All Progressives Congress, Dayo Israel, has warned the National Democratic Congress against attempting to rig the 2027 general elections in the South-East, saying such an action would attract consequences from residents of the region. The warning comes amid the political contest involving President Bola Tinubu, who hails from Lagos State in the South-West; NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi, a former Anambra State governor with a strong political following in the South-East; and candidates of other political parties. Obi was confirmed as the NDC’s presidential candidate for the 2027 election at the party’s national convention held in Abuja on May 30, 2026. He is expected to challenge Tinubu, the APC’s presidential candidate, in the poll. Israel said the people of the South-East had witnessed what he described as development programmes being implemented by the APC-led Federal Government through the South-East Development Commission. He listed industrialisation, gas development and agricultural programmes among the initiatives, arguing that they demonstrated the administration’s commitment to the region. The APC youth leader made the remarks in a post on his X account, @dayoisrael, on Tuesday, while addressing the NDC over the forthcoming elections. “Take note, NDC – There will be no community rigging in the South East in 2027. Like many Nigerians have alluded, if you try rigging in the South East, you face the consequence from the people of the grassroots,” he wrote. Israel further said the people of the region had witnessed projects being undertaken through the commission, adding that the development initiatives had strengthened support for President Bola Tinubu in the South-East. “Ala Igbo have seen the Industrialisation program, the Gas development program, the Agro development program And other projects by the APC through the South East Development Commission. “If you rig, you go for it. Ala Igbo is for Tinubu,” he added. Samuel Omotere Samuel Omotere is an experienced journalist covering human interest stories, pop culture, and digital trends.
